title: Actual bounded centered perturbation laws and finite canonical KL

target_statement: For an a.e.-strongly-measurable uniformly a.e.-bounded centered real f on a probability space, sufficiently small real e gives an actual withDensity probability law with density at least 1/2 a.e.; its canonical ENNReal KL equals ofReal of the compensated entropy integral, hence is finite.
